hypotheses.name: Certified-zero SwiGLU channel execution
hypotheses.causal_inputs: Fresh normalized x and actual gate weights/cast contract.
hypotheses.concurrent_unit: Channel certificates and surviving up/down tiles.
hypotheses.state_owners: Existing request/depth/layer KV owner and versioned hidden/residual owner. Immutable channel weights remain with compute owners.
hypotheses.exactness: Zero elimination is conditional on finite unused operands and matching cast/reduction semantics.
hypotheses.saved_work: Selected up rows and down columns.
hypotheses.baseline: Same-P native fused gate/up dense path plus generic exact zero skipping.
hypotheses.cheap_disproof: Count qualified zeros and removable tiles before engine work.
hypotheses.outcome: No zero supply in this bounded CPU reconstruction. Native GPU hit rate remains unmeasured.

hypotheses.name: Lossless arithmetic-component contraction
hypotheses.causal_inputs: Fresh current BF16 x, unchanged W, complete exact slice metadata.
hypotheses.concurrent_unit: Independent integer slice-pair contractions and reconstruction.
hypotheses.state_owners: Original KV owners unchanged. Arithmetic workers own static W slices and versioned partial sums.
hypotheses.exactness: Lossless operands do not imply the same FP32 accumulation result.
hypotheses.saved_work: Hypothesized cheaper operand/arithmetic path, not skipped recurrent passes.
hypotheses.baseline: Same-P native BF16 GEMM/TP and generic Ozaki/emulation controls.
hypotheses.cheap_disproof: Check exact representation width and full pair count, then qualify accumulation.
hypotheses.outcome: One-slice replacement fails for the tested format. Multiple slices and numerical gaps supply no supported engine headroom.

scope_limits: FP64 CPU gate projection followed by BF16/FP32 casts is not the native GPU gate/activation path.
Two bounded prompts are not independent benchmark requests.
Fixed-R4 samples do not establish adaptive hit rates.
Logical width-32 tiles are not measured kernel geometry.
Complete pair expansion counts do not bound every exact arithmetic algorithm.
No task-quality, E2E, traffic, or GPU-latency claim.
